historical_source_identity.meaning: Immutable relocation-time identity; current file is bound by this descriptor.

numeric_contract.constant_target: Only equality of all admitted target values produces the constant-target hold.
numeric_contract.integer_admission: Only integers exactly representable as binary64; other integers explicitly refuse before scoring or pair ranking. Finite floats retain their supplied values.
numeric_contract.response_loss: Scaled sum of squared residuals; SSE and MSE materialize independently. Exact rational fallback from the original admitted values rounds subnormal or overflow-boundary outputs once. A positive output rounded to zero or overflowing binary64 explicitly refuses.
numeric_contract.response_r2: Targets are shifted by their minimum then normalized by their range. SSE/SST uses mantissas and exponents, without materializing SST or squaring dimensional scales.

scope: Invented standard-library numeric controls only. No authentic inputs, reference comparisons, model fitting, external services or native scientific campaign. Complete cohort, protected-response boundaries, historical selection, population, uncertainty and all authentic scientific qualification holds remain unchanged.
